en.headline: Century-old Chun On Pawn Shop becomes community pop-up
en.dek: The former pawn shop at 91 Wan Chai Road now hosts exhibitions, a café and free community programmes until mid-December under Project House @ Chun On Pawn.
body: The historic Chun On Pawn Shop building on Wan Chai Road has been temporarily converted into a shared community space known as Project House @ Chun On Pawn.

Organised by One Bite Social and the Lion Rock Heritage Foundation, the venue offers exhibitions on the building’s pawnshop history, casual seating, reading areas and regular workshops. A pop-up café operated by Coffee Boats serves from the original high counter.
The space runs from mid-August to 19 December 2026. Opening hours are Monday to Thursday 9am to 6pm, Friday 12pm to 9pm and Saturday 12pm to 6pm; it is closed on Sundays. Entry is free.

zh.headline: 百年振安大押變社區共享空間 開放至12月
zh.dek: 灣仔道91號前振安大押現以「壹當」名義營運展覽、咖啡及免費社區活動，開放至12月19日。
body: 灣仔道91號歷史建築振安大押已暫時改為社區共享空間「壹當」（Project House @ Chun On Pawn）。
由壹社及獅子山文化基金會推動，場內設有當舖歷史展覽、休息區、閱讀角落及定期工作坊。Coffee Boats於原有高櫃檯開設期間限定咖啡店。
空間由8月中開放至2026年12月19日。開放時間為周一至周四上午9時至下午6時、周五中午12時至晚上9時、周六中午12時至下午6時，周日休息。入場免費。
